scope: Structure (role=group, legend part, aria-labelledby, authored legend), disabled propagation to kit controls at any depth and through nested fieldsets, data-disabled on host and legend, of the web component in happy-dom (node:test); the React renderer's server markup (native fieldset, legend div, context disabled on kit hosts, composed form equal to the preset) and state parity with the web component; resolver numbers. Rendered spacing is checked by apps/studio/geometry-check.html; screen-reader output is not certified.

checks.covers: no native elements, role=group named by the legend, generated and authored legends, disabled reaching inputs, fields, radio groups and radios at any depth and a nested fieldset, data-disabled on host and legend, re-enabling
resolveFieldset: the collection gap, gapUnits and the gap attribute, no box

native fieldset markup and classes, legend div wired by aria-labelledby, disabled reaching kit hosts through context, Fieldset.Root + Fieldset.Legend equal to the preset, state parity with the web component

limitations: The source list is the direct sources, not every transitive dependency.
React custom-ARIA hosts (Listbox, Palette) get data-disabled from a disabled Fieldset, but their own behavior follows their disabled prop only.

Manual geometry review (2026-11-02, studio #/components?family=fields, light and dark, u = 3, 4, theme 4.5, 6): legend and fields 2u apart (collection gap; geometry-check honours the gap attribute), no box; growth: a long legend wraps and fields keep their own widths; RTL: a column, the legend aligns to the inline start; focus: the fieldset draws no contour, each control keeps its ring; parity: react-check.html twins fs / fsd match (fails []).
